```sql
-- test_sql
select
    l_discount
from
    lineitem
where
    l_discount between .03 and .06;
```
```python
statement = sqlparse.parse(test_sql)[0]

for token in statement.tokens:

        for sub_token in token.tokens:
            if sub_token.value in [' ', '\n']: continue
            print(str(type(sub_token)).ljust(35, ' '),  sub_token)
```
